title: Lotte reshuffles biz portfolio with Busan store sale to Shinsegae
caption:
Lotte Shopping is offloading its Centum City outlet to Shinsegae as part of a major retail reorganization. This shift aims to sharpen the company's focus on its most competitive locations.

Source: En - Lotte reshuffles biz portfolio with Busan store sale to Shinsegae
